description:
Simulate a multi-participant meeting to test moderator controls. 

1. You start with Firefox open at 'http://localhost:8080/virtual-fitness-class'. 
2. Join the meeting as 'FitnessCoach' (you will be the moderator). 
3. Open a NEW browser tab (Ctrl+T) and join the SAME meeting URL as 'ClassHelper'. 
4. Switch back to the 'FitnessCoach' tab. 
5. Open the Participants panel, find 'ClassHelper', and grant them Moderator rights using the context menu (three dots). 
6. Take a screenshot of the participants panel showing ClassHelper as a moderator and save it to '/home/ga/moderator_granted.png'.
